extracted.name: Pomegranate and Pear Salad
extracted.description: This Pomegranate and Pear Salad is a simple salad with feta cheese, pears, almonds, and pomegranates over a bed of fresh spinach, drizzled with a homemade dressing. It only takes 15 minutes and is sure to impress any guest!
ingredient_lines: 8 cups baby spinach leaves (, or mixed greens or arugula)
2 large ripe pears (, cored and sliced)
2 ounces crumbled goat, feta, or gorgonzola cheese
1/2 cup slivered almonds, walnuts or pistachios
1/4 cup apple cider vinegar ((or champagne vinegar))
salt and freshly ground black pepper (, to taste)
instruction_lines: Place all salad ingredients in a large bowl.
Make the dressing by whisking all ingredients together.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss to combine. Serve immediately.
